What was the UN created to prevent?
国連は何を防ぐためにつくられた？

A  Another world war
B  International trade
C  Migration
A · Another world war
1945: peace and security, human rights, and cooperation.
1945年。平和と安全、人権、国際協力。
https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter/full-text

The Charter preamble responds to two world wars. The UN came into existence on 24 October 1945. Avoid claiming its creation ended war. Ask: what can an institution prevent if states refuse to cooperate?
How many countries are UN members?
国連の加盟国はいくつ？
B · 193 Member States
51 founding members. Membership is not the same as counting every state or territory.
創設時は51か国。国・地域の総数とは別。
https://www.un.org/en/about-us/

Verified 15 November 2026. The Holy See and State of Palestine are non-member observer States, not two additional Member States. Do not confuse UN membership with diplomatic recognition by every state.
Do all countries have the same power?
加盟国の力は平等？
A  Yes       B  No       C  It depends on the organ
C · It depends on the organ

General Assembly: one member, one vote.
Security Council: five states have a veto.
総会は一国一票。安保理は5か国に拒否権。
https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter/full-text

Articles 2 and 18 establish sovereign equality and one vote per General Assembly member. Equality of voting does not establish equal influence, resources, representation of people, or equal outcomes within countries. GA resolutions are generally recommendations, with important institutional and budgetary powers.
Can one country block 14 others?
1か国がほかの14か国を止められる？
A  Never       B  Sometimes
B · On substantive Security Council votes
A permanent member’s negative vote can block adoption. An abstention does not.
常任理事国の反対は採択を阻止できる。棄権は別。
https://main.un.org/securitycouncil/en/content/voting-system

Council has 15 members. Substantive adoption ordinarily requires nine affirmative votes and no veto by the five permanent members. Procedural votes have no veto. Permanent members: China, France, Russian Federation, UK, US. Ten elected members serve two-year terms. Discuss who has no permanent seat.
Who chooses the Secretary-General?
事務総長を選ぶのは誰？

A  A global public election
B  The General Assembly alone
C  Assembly + Security Council
C · Appointment with a Council recommendation
The General Assembly appoints on the Security Council’s recommendation.
安保理の勧告に基づき、総会が任命する。
https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter/chapter-15

Charter Article 97. Permanent-member veto power affects the recommendation. This is not a direct global election. The Charter does not prescribe a five-year term, although five-year appointments have become practice. Agency heads have different selection rules.
Does the UN have its own army?
国連には独自の常備軍がある？
A  Yes       B  No
B · No standing army
Member States contribute military and police personnel. The UN also recruits civilians.
加盟国が軍・警察要員を提供。文民職員も働く。
https://ask.un.org/faq/177270

Distinguish troops provided by states, civilian mission staff, humanitarian agencies and NGOs. A civilian GIS professional is not automatically a soldier or blue-helmeted peacekeeper. Missions have different mandates.
Does every UN mission do the same work?
国連のミッションはどれも同じ？
A  Yes       B  No
B · The mandate matters
Peacekeeping, political work, and humanitarian operations differ.
平和維持、政治、人道支援では役割が異なる。
https://peacekeeping.un.org/en/principles-of-peacekeeping

Peacekeeping principles include consent of main parties, impartiality, and non-use of force except self-defence and defence of mandate. Robust peacekeeping is distinct from peace enforcement. Illustrative civilian tasks: logistics, analysis and mapping; not a description of Kana’s actual employer or duties.
Must you study diplomacy to work there?
国連で働くには外交を専攻する必要がある？
A  Yes       B  No
B · The job decides the skills
A map, a database, or a supply route can be part of the work.
地図、データベース、物資の経路も仕事を支える。
https://careers.un.org/

Illustrative skills rather than a current vacancy: GIS, planning, engineering, logistics, languages and analysis. Requirements are vacancy-specific. Do not imply that a GIS qualification guarantees employment. Ask students to identify a skill they can demonstrate with a portfolio.
Is there one entrance exam for every UN job?
国連の仕事はすべて同じ採用試験？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Several routes, different eligibility
Vacancies, YPP, JPO programmes, volunteering, and internships have different rules.
公募、YPP、JPO、ボランティア、インターンは条件が違う。
https://careers.un.org/ypp?language=en

YPP is a UN Secretariat route, not an exam for the entire UN system. Relevant first degree, English or French, age 32 or younger, participating nationality: check the current year and exam area. JPO sponsorship and criteria vary. Volunteers and interns are not equivalent to staff appointments. Never pay a recruitment fee. Official vacancies are the starting point.
Does getting hired mean a job for life?
採用されたら一生働ける？
A  Yes       B  No
B · A contract has an end date
Secretariat rules: temporary, under one year; fixed-term, one to five years at a time.
事務局規則では臨時任用は1年未満。有期任用は1〜5年。
https://policy.un.org/en/appointment-and-promotion

These are appointment types, not average career length or a promise of renewal. Continuing appointments also exist. Consultants, volunteers, troops and other agencies have different arrangements. Time in a mission, a posting and an entire UN career are different questions. Ask Kana about her experience without presuming her contract.
Do all UN workers earn the same salary?
国連で働く人の給与は同じ？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Category, grade, step, and location matter
International Professional pay includes net base salary and post adjustment.
国際採用の専門職は基本給と勤務地調整額が中心。
https://icsc.un.org/home/salaryscales

ICSC publishes professional P-1 to P-5 and higher-grade scales. General Service salaries are locally based. This formula does not describe every UN worker. No universal annual salary can be quoted responsibly without grade, step, duty station and effective date. Pension/insurance deductions and personal circumstances affect actual payment. Use the official scale page for a live classroom lookup.
Why can the same grade pay differently by city?
同じ等級でも都市によって給与が違うのは？

A  Cost of living
B  Each manager invents a salary
A · Post adjustment
It aims to preserve purchasing power across duty stations.
勤務地間の購買力の差を調整するため。
https://icsc.un.org/Home/PostAdjustment

Illustrative calculation only: net base $60,000/year with post adjustment 40% gives $84,000/year before other deductions and entitlements. These numbers are NOT an actual grade, city or current salary offer. Net base already reflects staff assessment; do not label the result universal take-home pay. Ask what information is still missing.
Is danger pay permission to take any risk?
危険手当があれば、どんなリスクも取ってよい？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Money does not remove the risk
ICSC lists US$1,698/month for eligible internationally recruited staff.
対象となる国際採用職員は月額1,698米ドルと掲載。
https://icsc.un.org/Resources/FAQs/what-is-the-amount-of-danger-p.htm

Verified 15 November 2026 on the ICSC FAQ. Not all staff or locations qualify. Local staff amounts differ. Eligibility, designated locations and prorating rules apply and may change. Danger pay is distinct from hardship allowances and is not compensation for accepting unlimited risk.
Can you simply decide to travel into a conflict zone?
紛争地域へ自分の判断だけで出張できる？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Security arrangements come first
Risk assessment, travel clearance, communications, and contingency plans matter.
リスク評価、渡航承認、連絡手段、緊急時の計画。
https://www.un.org/safety-and-security/en/expertise/risk-management

UNDSS describes security risk management and measures including tracking, advisories, protective equipment, relocation and evacuation. Actual requirements vary by agency and location. This is classroom orientation, not operational travel guidance. Plans cannot guarantee rescue, safe access or zero risk.
Does support end when the working day ends?
勤務が終われば支援も終わる？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Health and recovery matter too
Counselling, medical support, and designated rest-and-recuperation arrangements exist.
心理相談、医療、指定勤務地の休養制度もある。

https://www.un.org/safety-and-security/en/critical-incident-stress-management
https://icsc.un.org/Home/RestRecuperation

R&R is for designated hazardous/stressful duty stations with applicable eligibility and cycles. It is not simply extra annual leave. Access, insurance, family accompaniment and evacuation arrangements depend on appointment and context. Do not promise equal evacuation arrangements for national and international personnel. Ask whose support is easiest to overlook.
Does a UN badge guarantee safety or immunity from every law?
国連の身分証があれば安全で、どの法律も適用されない？
A  Yes       B  No
B · Legal protection is not a physical shield
International rules protect personnel. Staff still have duties and accountability.
職員を守る国際的規則はある。職員にも義務と責任がある。

https://www.un.org/law/cod/safety.htm
https://www.un.org/en/coronavirus/know-your-legal-rights

The 1994 Safety Convention protects covered UN and associated personnel within its scope; applicability depends on operation and treaty obligations. Host-state agreements and applicable international humanitarian law also matter. Privileges/immunities are functional, not personal impunity. Local laws and conduct rules still matter. No legal instrument guarantees physical safety.
Would sharing a detailed map always help?
詳しい地図の公開は、いつでも役に立つ？
A  Yes       B  It depends
B · Who can use it, and against whom?
A classroom scenario: shelter locations may aid response or expose people to harm.
避難場所の情報は支援にも、危害にも使われ得る。
https://www.un.org/safety-and-security/en/expertise/risk-management

This is an illustrative ethical scenario, not a quoted UN incident or a field protocol. Discuss intended users, consent, precision, access restrictions and whether a less detailed product would meet the need. Ask Kana how she makes these decisions in her own role.
